⚠️ WARNING: SENSITIVE CONTENT 
This experience contains intense flashing lights, loud noises, and sudden, unpredictable jumpscares. It may not be suitable for players with photosensitive epilepsy or heart conditions.

The Last Bus 13:
It's late. Too late.
You're just a student trying to get home... but the last bus stop you find is abandoned.

No one is here.
Only restless spirits remain.

Just silence... and something watching.

Will you make it out, or will this be your last night?

● Play solo or survive together in multiplayer

#TheLastBus13 #Horror #HorrorMultiplayer
